newsitem.title: USA: Tribune shares up as Q3 EPS tops consensus.
newsitem.headline: Tribune shares up as Q3 EPS tops consensus.

text.p: Tribune Co's stock rose after the company posted third-quarter earnings that exceeded the Wall Street consensus estimate of $0.86 a primary share .
The multimedia company earned $1.00 per primary share and $0.92 per diluted share in the third quarter.
"Results were better than expected," said analyst Mary Ann Winter of Brown Brothers Harriman, who had projected earnings of $0.83 per diluted share.
Because of the strong performance, Prudential Securities analyst Melissa Cook raised her 1996 earnings estimate to $3.80 per diluted share from $3.75.
On the New York Stock Exchange, Tribune was trading at 82-1/2, up 1-3/8, at 1430 EDT/1730 GMT.
